description: Run a multi-step flow in the tenant's hosted browser — this is the tool for portals that have no API and need a login. Steps are NAMED, not JavaScript: goto (url), type (selector + value OR secret), click (selector, optional), wait_for (selector or ms, optional), read (selector + as, optional attribute), count (selector + as). Passwords are NEVER passed in: give `secret: "<name>"` on a type step and list the name under `secrets` as { name: { provider, field } } — the value is fetched from the tenant vault at runtime, never appears in the call, the generated code or the result. Every goto address is checked BEFORE the browser starts; internal and cloud-metadata addresses are refused. Optional stealth asks Browserless to reduce automation signals; it does not solve or bypass CAPTCHA challenges. Returns what the read/count steps collected plus a per-step trace, with any secret value blanked out. Use browser_fetch_page instead when one page and no login is enough.

secrets.description: Name -> { provider, field } from the tenant vault, e.g. { "passwort": { "provider": "freelancermap", "field": "password" } }.

stealth.description: Enable Browserless stealth launch mode. Does not solve CAPTCHA challenges.

steps.description: The steps in order. At least one goto.

name: browser_run_flow
